quantize_model_parameters: quantize a PyTorch model's parameters using BaseQuantizer to reduce model size for inference
restore_quantized_state: restore a quantized model state from a saved dictionary back onto a PyTorch model
get_quantized_state: get the quantized state of a model with optional bitpacking for optimal storage
compressed_model_size: compute the compressed quantized model size in MB using parallel zlib compression
enter_quantize_context: use the enter_quantize context manager to temporarily quantize a model then auto-unquantize
